item.description:
Copy a profile to another Mac

  • Export a password-protected .subfuse file containing one profile’s saved subscriptions, usage, costs, renewals and remembered Claude/Cursor website sessions.
  • Restore beside existing profiles without switching profiles or overwriting existing sign-ins. Wrong passwords, changed files and collisions restore nothing.
  • ChatGPT and Gemini still use the destination Mac’s signed-in ChatGPT and Antigravity desktop apps. Providers can expire a website session.
  • No upload, saved password, account or sync. Anyone with the file and password can use its sessions. Website data is limited to 200 MB.

SubFuse must be idle. If a selected website session was used this launch, turn off scheduled refresh, quit/reopen and copy before refreshing.

Validated with synthetic stores and an isolated WebKit marker on macOS 27.2. Live provider sign-ins have not yet been transferred between two Macs in testing.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. Existing profiles are preserved.
